verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents scoped API keys that grant only the Read or Write resource permissions you assign on specific APIs, rather than full account access, so you can issue least-privilege credentials. Its agent tooling adds guardrails: AgentOS MCP uses OAuth and blocks money-out actions by default, and CLI authorization is role-gated. Missing for 10: agent-specific credential issuance guidance (e.g. per-agent keys, expiry, revocation), deeper docs on the scope catalog, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: A scoped API key grants only the resource permissions you assign (Read or Write on specific APIs), instead of full account access.
It shares the safety guardrails of other AgentOS components, including no money-out actions by default. Authentication uses OAuth against your production Airwallex account.
